'''Fleet Tactics 241''' was a guest lecture at the [[Duluur Sector Naval Academy]] given by [[Rear Admiral/Legends|Rear Admiral]] [[Michael Unther]]. It covered the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy's]] role in [[planetary assault tactics]].
